entities.summary: Hans-Martin Trepp was an ice hockey player for EHC Arosa and the Swiss national team where he scored 83 goals in 94 matches. He won a bronze medal at the 1948 Winter Olympics. He appeared in the World Championships four times, winning three bronze medals in 1950, 1951 and 1953.
